source: First, programming spaces and physical structures are not identical. ZXNAME0000XZ global memory is an address space visible across the grid. A global load can hit an on-chip cache. ZXNAME0001XZ local memory is private to one thread, yet its backing storage is in device memory.[1][3]
zh: 首先，编程空间和物理结构并不相同。 ZXNAME0000XZ 全局内存是整个网格可见的地址空间。全局负载可以命中片上缓存。 ZXNAME0001XZ 本地内存是一个线程私有的，但其后备存储位于设备内存中。[1][3]
